name: Tessera Industries Holographic Distraction Projector HDP-5
product_name: Tessera Industries Holographic Distraction Projector HDP-5
description: A throwable device that projects a 3-meter holographic scene — an explosion, a running person, a vehicle crash, or other attention-grabbing event — that lasts for 15 seconds. The HDP-5 is a single-use distraction tool designed to draw attention and surveillance focus to one location while the operator moves through another. The holographic projection includes simulated sound and a thermal signature generator that fools infrared sensors, creating a multi-sensory deception that is convincing for the critical seconds needed to slip past security.
story_hooks: An HDP-5 projecting a fake explosion in a crowded area caused a stampede — the hologram was intended as a distraction for a nearby operation, but the panic resulted in injuries and deaths.
HDP-5 units have been modified to project realistic holographic people that walk, talk, and interact — creating phantom witnesses and suspects that complicate crime scene reconstruction.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, angular throwable device resembling a polyhedral die or crystalline grenade. The form factor is deliberately irregular to tumble naturally when thrown. Housing is translucent in places, revealing prismatic internal optics and a faintly glowing power cell core. Edges are beveled and grip-friendly despite its small size.
physical_description.dimensions: 6 cm (width) × 5 cm (height) × 5 cm (depth) — palm-sized, easily concealed in a closed fist
physical_description.weight_description: 150 grams — light enough to throw with accuracy, heavy enough to travel 15+ meters with a good arm
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade polymer composite with embedded holographic projection matrices; translucent polycarbonate panels over internal mechanisms
physical_description.finish: Matte with subtle iridescent coating that shifts color in light; smooth grip sections contrast with textured throw surfaces for control
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with deep teal accents; internal optics glow faint cyan when active; Tessera Industries branding in silver
physical_description.interface_elements: Single large twist-lock activation ring (top hemisphere) with detent positions; no screen or buttons — fully mechanical activation. Small status LED (green/red) on one corner. Recessed maintenance port on base with Tessera proprietary seal.
distinctive_features: Internal holographic projection lens visible through translucent side panel, reflecting light like a prism
Tessera Industries logo (geometric Φ-derived symbol) etched on two faces
Faint heat shimmer visible around one edge when powered (thermal generator test)
Beveled facets create interesting light patterns; intentionally designed to catch light during throw trajectory for visual tracking
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA INDUSTRIES | HDP-5 DISTRACTION MODULE | Φ LICENSED TIER 3+ | SINGLE USE | Date code on base; small regulatory stamps (GLMZ safety compliance, thermal emitter certification)
physical_description.condition_typical: Fresh units show pristine finish; after use, the device typically has minor scuff marks from impact and tumbling. The twist-lock shows slight wear from activation. Internal optics may show minor dust accumulation but remain functional. Post-deployment units are non-recoverable (self-destruct after 20 seconds)
